{{Top|leg|title=Unidentified ''Far Orbit'' crew member}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''crew member''' of the ''[[Far Orbit]]'' was present on [[StarForge Station]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The crew member, alongside [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij]], helped finalize the deal with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that allowed the ''Far Orbit'' to serve as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] vessel for the Alliance.<ref name="PW">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=Preparing for War}}</ref>
